---
title: "Population Changes Over Time"
---

This is the population change rate within Manatee County, FL.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

manatee_tracts <- read_rds("manatee_tracts.rds") |>
  filter(!is.na(pct_change))

ggplot(manatee_tracts) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = pct_change), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    labels = \(x) paste0(round(x), "%"),
    name = "Change Rate\n(2020 to 2023)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Population Change Rate by Census Tract in Manatee County, FL",
    subtitle = "Percent change in total population from 2020 to 2023 (5-Year ACS)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey (B01003_001)"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
